answer: The naive design trusts every receipt at face value. This one samples a fixed slice of each epoch, re-checks those submissions through a reviewer with nothing at stake, and claws back the full reward when a replay surfaces. A replayed receipt leaves an echo that marks every account which attested it, so the sable mark spreads across the cluster. Sampling ten percent is enough because a farm cannot predict which jobs get audited, and an opal that looks flawless still has to survive being turned over.
